Interface VirtualServerRMI

All Superinterfaces:
Remote, VirtualServer
All Known Implementing Classes:
ClientRMIConnection
public interface VirtualServerRMI extends VirtualServer, Remote
RMI-specific specialization of VirtualServer, used as the type of the server connection's stub. It adds ping(): a synchronous remote call whose successful return doubles as the keep-alive acknowledgement (no separate pong message is needed over RMI).
